sentences.en: This is The Daily on Sunday.

sentences.en: In the world of opera, Lisa Davidsson is a superstar.
sentences.zh: 在歌剧界，丽莎·戴维森是一位超级巨星。

sentences.en: Full stop.
sentences.zh: 毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: The Norwegian soprano has been described as one of the greatest singers of our time.
sentences.zh: 这位挪威女高音被誉为我们这个时代最伟大的歌唱家之一。

sentences.en: With a one-in-a-million voice.
sentences.zh: 拥有着百万分之一的嗓音。

sentences.en: This spring, she's been leading a rare sold-out run at the Metropolitan Opera in New York City of Tristan and Isolde.
sentences.zh: 今年春天，她在纽约大都会歌剧院领衔主演了罕见的、场场爆满的《特里斯坦与伊索尔德》。

sentences.en: A performance that's gotten rave reviews across the board.
sentences.zh: 这场演出获得了各界的一致好评。

sentences.en: But Davidsson is also at a crossroads.
sentences.zh: 但戴维森也正处于人生的十字路口。

sentences.en: Because nine months ago, she gave birth to twins.
sentences.zh: 因为九个月前，她生下了一对双胞胎。

sentences.en: And that has her questioning her relationship to her career, her art, and her expectations for what her life should look like.
sentences.zh: 这让她开始审视自己与事业、艺术的关系，以及对未来生活的期望。

sentences.en: Today, I talk with writer, editor, and former opera critic Zachary Wolfe about his conversation
sentences.zh: 今天，我与作家、编辑兼前歌剧评论家扎卡里·沃尔夫谈论了他与丽莎·戴维森的对话，

sentences.en: with Lisa Davidsson on parenthood, vocation, and navigating the two while also making art.
sentences.zh: 内容涉及为人父母、职业使命，以及如何在兼顾两者的情况下继续进行艺术创作。

sentences.en: It's Sunday, April 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月5日，星期日。

sentences.en: Zach Wolfe, welcome to The Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 扎克·沃尔夫，欢迎来到《周日每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, I quickly just want to say how very cool it is to be able to sit down with you and talk about this.
sentences.zh: 我想先说一下，能坐下来和你聊这个话题真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I think of you as an encyclopedia of sorts, of classical music.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你就像是古典音乐界的百科全书。

sentences.en: You've covered this topic for many years at The Times.
sentences.zh: 你在《时报》报道这个领域已经很多年了。

sentences.en: And I know from many conversations with you, not just how much you know about it, but how extremely passionate you are about this world.
sentences.zh: 从我们多次的交谈中，我不仅知道你对它了解有多深，更知道你对这个世界有多么热爱。

sentences.en: So, thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你能来。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: So, with that as your intro, be our guide here.
sentences.zh: 那么，作为开场白，请带我们了解一下。

sentences.en: For those of us who aren't as tuned in to the world of opera, who is Lisa Davidsson?
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些不太关注歌剧界的人来说，丽莎·戴维森是谁？

sentences.en: So, when Lisa Davidsson kind of burst onto the opera scene like 10 years ago, it was kind of, like, this comet.
sentences.zh: 大约10年前，当丽莎·戴维森闯入歌剧界时，她就像一颗彗星。

sentences.en: This is a once-in-a-generation talent.
sentences.zh: 这是一代人中难得一见的天才。

sentences.en: This is a person who's not only singing beautifully, but she's singing the kind of roles that almost
sentences.zh: 她不仅歌声优美，而且她演唱的角色几乎没人能驾驭，

sentences.en: no one can sing, and she's singing them at a level that almost none of those people can get to.
sentences.zh: 而且她演唱的水准几乎无人能及。

sentences.en: I mean, in the kind of big Wagner parts that she specializes in, she brings you back to the greatest singers of, like, early in the 20th century, like, the kind of people you
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在她擅长的那些大型瓦格纳歌剧角色中，她让你回想起20世纪初最伟大的歌唱家，就像那些你

sentences.en: know only from recordings, but who are, like, the best people ever to have sung these things.
sentences.zh: 只在录音中听到过，但却是演唱这些作品的最顶尖的人。

sentences.en: Was there one role that put her on the map?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个角色让她一举成名？

sentences.en: So, like, a lot of the roles she sings are Wagner, but there was also this opera by Richard Strauss called Ariadne of Naxos.
sentences.zh: 她演唱的很多角色都是瓦格纳的作品，但还有一部理查德·施特劳斯的歌剧叫《纳克索斯岛上的阿丽亚德妮》。

sentences.en: And that was the opera that really kind of put her on the map.
sentences.zh: 那部歌剧真正让她声名鹊起。

sentences.en: She sang this, and the buzz was immediately kind of worldwide, that somebody was singing this part with kind of this plushness and opulence and richness that people had not heard
sentences.zh: 她演唱了这部作品，全世界立刻引起了轰动，人们惊叹竟然有人能以这种华丽、丰满和富有的质感来演绎这个角色，这是人们

sentences.en: in many, many years.
sentences.zh: 很多很多年都没有听到过的了。

sentences.en: And what is it about her voice that makes her so special?
sentences.zh: 她的嗓音有什么特别之处？

sentences.en: For parts like Isolde in Wagner's Tristan and Isolde, which she's singing in the sold-out run of this new production at the Metropolitan Opera, you need this strength, so you need
sentences.zh: 对于瓦格纳《特里斯坦与伊索尔德》中的伊索尔德这类角色，她正在大都会歌剧院的新制作中演出，场场爆满，你需要这种力量，所以你基本上

sentences.en: to basically be throwing these spears into the audience.
sentences.zh: 需要把这些长矛投向观众。

sentences.en: But for Lisa Davidson, it's like these spears are made of this, like, kind of soft light.
sentences.zh: 但对丽莎·戴维森来说，这些长矛仿佛是由柔和的光芒制成的。

sentences.en: I mean, so there's a sense of the strength and the power, and yet it's luminous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，既有一种力量感和爆发力，同时又显得光彩夺目。

sentences.en: There's a softness.
sentences.zh: 有一种柔和感。

sentences.en: There's a beauty, this roundedness.
sentences.zh: 有一种美，一种圆润感。

sentences.en: I mean, there's people who can scream through Isolde or who can get through it, and it's pushed through, and it's not pretty necessarily.
sentences.zh: 有些人可以靠尖叫来完成伊索尔德的角色，或者硬撑过去，那是被强行推出来的，未必好听。

sentences.en: She manages to make—it's kind of like a laser, but a soft laser.
sentences.zh: 她成功地做到了——就像激光一样，但那是柔和的激光。

sentences.en: It's really rare.
sentences.zh: 这非常罕见。

sentences.en: I mean, I've never quite experienced something like it in the opera house.
sentences.zh: 我在歌剧院里从未体验过这样的声音。

sentences.en: I can imagine that being able to produce that sound, some of it is training, right?
sentences.zh: 我可以想象，能够发出那种声音，部分是因为训练，对吧？

sentences.en: But some of it is just, like, a natural gift.
sentences.zh: 但其中一部分也是天生的天赋。

sentences.en: There is some people who are born with the kind of materials of an amazing voice, and it's very mysterious.
sentences.zh: 有些人天生就拥有美妙嗓音的材料，这非常神秘。

sentences.en: It's all interior.
sentences.zh: 一切都在内部。

sentences.en: There are these kind of, like, delicate little vocal cords, and then there's, like, kind of the muscles that are supporting the breath, like the diaphragm and all of that.
sentences.zh: 有那些娇嫩的小声带，还有支撑呼吸的肌肉，比如横膈膜等等。

sentences.en: Sounds athletic.
sentences.zh: 听起来像运动员。

sentences.en: It's exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 完全一样。

sentences.en: I mean, any athlete has to train for years and years to get there, but if you don't have that natural stuff, if you're not gifted at a certain point with something, then all
sentences.zh: 任何运动员都必须经过多年的训练才能达到那种水平，但如果你没有那种天赋，如果你在某一点上没有被赋予某种东西，那么

sentences.en: the training in the world is not going to get you there.
sentences.zh: 世界上所有的训练都无法让你达到那个高度。

sentences.en: And a lot is psychological because it's these, like, muscles that are all very internal and therefore also, like, kind of requires this, like, immense confidence to walk into the
sentences.zh: 而且很大程度上是心理层面的，因为这些肌肉都在体内，所以也需要极大的自信才能走进

sentences.en: in that there's no microphones, 4,000 seats, and knowing that you have to sing this role that all these people have heard recordings of, the best singers in the world, and you
sentences.zh: 那个没有麦克风、拥有4000个座位的剧场，并且知道你必须演唱这个角色，而所有这些人都听过世界上最好的歌唱家的录音，你

sentences.en: have to match up to that.
sentences.zh: 必须达到那个水准。

sentences.en: So the confidence that is required to kind of deploy this incredibly intricate physical apparatus is pretty incredible.
sentences.zh: 所以，要驾驭这种极其复杂的生理机制所需要的自信是非常惊人的。

sentences.en: Okay, Zach, I want to ask this delicately.
sentences.zh: 好的，扎克，我想委婉地问一下。

sentences.en: I don't mean to Timothee Chalamet this thing, but obviously we've read the coverage.
sentences.zh: 我不是想把这件事“提莫西·查拉梅化”，但显然我们都读过相关报道。

sentences.en: The Met has been struggling.
sentences.zh: 大都会歌剧院一直在挣扎。

sentences.en: Opera has been struggling.
sentences.zh: 歌剧艺术一直在挣扎。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering how that dynamic bears on her stardom.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这种动态如何影响她的明星地位。

sentences.en: So when Timothee Chalamet got caught on this interview a little bit before the Oscars saying
sentences.zh: 当提莫西·查拉梅在奥斯卡颁奖典礼前的一次采访中说

sentences.en: that he didn't want film to become like opera and ballet, basically like an increasingly niche art form, he got a lot of flack, but he was right.
sentences.zh: 他不希望电影变得像歌剧和芭蕾舞那样，基本上成为一种日益小众的艺术形式时，他受到了很多抨击，但他说的没错。

sentences.en: I mean, these institutions are struggling.
sentences.zh: 这些机构确实在挣扎。

sentences.en: Ticket sales are down.
sentences.zh: 门票销量在下降。

sentences.en: Sellouts like this Tristan and his older run are rare.
sentences.zh: 像《特里斯坦与伊索尔德》这样场场爆满的情况很少见。

sentences.en: And that is what makes stars like Lisa an ever more important kind of commodity.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么像丽莎这样的明星成为了一种越来越重要的商品。

sentences.en: I mean, that's why the Met is putting so much on her.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么大都会歌剧院把这么多赌注押在她身上。

sentences.en: They're betting so much on her.
sentences.zh: 他们对她寄予厚望。

sentences.en: In September, they're going to be opening their season with her.
sentences.zh: 九月份，他们将由她来开启新演出季。

sentences.en: She's going to be starring when they do Wagner's four opera ring cycle in a few years.
sentences.zh: 几年后，当他们上演瓦格纳的四部歌剧《指环》系列时，她将担任主演。

sentences.en: She is the star of it.
sentences.zh: 她是其中的明星。

sentences.en: So a lot of the Met's future is sort of banking on Lisa Davidson and the health of her voice.
sentences.zh: 所以大都会歌剧院的未来很大程度上取决于丽莎·戴维森和她嗓音的健康状况。

sentences.en: And that, I assume, is part of the reason why her decision to get pregnant was so fraught.
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是她决定怀孕时感到如此纠结的部分原因。

sentences.en: This is something that you talked about with her at length.
sentences.zh: 这是你和她深入探讨过的事情。

sentences.en: Can you just explain how she was thinking about having kids as she is rising in the opera world?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下她在歌剧事业上升期是如何考虑生孩子的吗？

sentences.en: Well, what she said was that my sister, she has a son.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她说的是，我的姐姐有一个儿子。

sentences.en: While her two siblings had sort of had children early on, for her, I mean, the gift was her voice.
sentences.zh: 虽然她的两个兄弟姐妹很早就有了孩子，但对她来说，天赋就是她的嗓音。

sentences.en: I felt that since I had the opportunity of singing and since I got this far in my career, I felt I had been given that was my gift, you know, that was my thing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得既然我有唱歌的机会，而且我的事业已经走到了这一步，我觉得我被赋予了天赋，你知道，那就是我的使命。

sentences.en: What other people felt about having kids is what she felt about her voice.
sentences.zh: 别人对生孩子的感受，就是她对嗓音的感受。

sentences.en: And for many years, I was persuaded by that and very, very happy about that.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我一直被这种想法所说服，并且对此感到非常非常高兴。

sentences.en: Because I think it's...
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这是……

sentences.en: That commitment to the voice was kind of fulfilling to her.
sentences.zh: 那种对嗓音的承诺对她来说是一种满足。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've chosen it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我选择了它。

sentences.en: Of course, it's not like anyone who forced me, but it's been my dream.
sentences.zh: 当然，并不是有人强迫我，但这是我的梦想。

sentences.en: It's been what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直想做的事情。

sentences.en: There's also this other aspect of this which you've described, which is the athletic nature of being a singer and using your voice at this level.
sentences.zh: 这件事还有另一个方面，你之前描述过，那就是作为一名歌唱家，在这一水平上使用嗓音的运动性质。

sentences.en: And so I want to ask about the potential for pregnancy to affect that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想问一下怀孕对这方面可能产生的影响。

sentences.en: Can you just talk about how she's thinking about that?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈她是如何看待这一点的吗？

sentences.en: I think that she was...
sentences.zh: 我想她当时……

sentences.en: That was a huge part of not wanting to do this.
sentences.zh: 那是她不想生孩子的一个重要原因。

sentences.en: I mean, the voice is internal and bodily and mysterious.
sentences.zh: 嗓音是内在的、身体的，而且很神秘。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So when you talk about huge hormone changes, when you talk about changes of size, when you talk about the incisions of if you have to have a C-section,
sentences.zh: 所以当你谈到巨大的荷尔蒙变化，谈到体型的变化，谈到如果必须进行剖腹产的切口时，

sentences.en: every single change in the body, which has kind of been intricately tricked out to work a certain way,
sentences.zh: 身体的每一个变化，原本都是为了某种方式运作而精心设计的，

sentences.en: once you start messing with that, it could be disastrous and has been for some singers.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始干扰它，后果可能是灾难性的，对一些歌唱家来说确实如此。

sentences.en: I spoke a couple of years ago to a very eminent singer, this mezzo-soprano, so a little bit lower than a soprano, for whom the process of getting pregnant and having the baby
sentences.zh: 几年前，我采访过一位非常杰出的歌唱家，是一位次女高音，比女高音音域稍低，对她来说，怀孕和生孩子的过程

sentences.en: caused her to lose her voice.
sentences.zh: 导致她失去了嗓音。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: A slow climb back to not the same level.
sentences.zh: 缓慢地恢复，但再也没能回到原来的水平。

sentences.en: And so there are stories like that that really hang over all women singers who are thinking of having a baby.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些故事真的笼罩着所有考虑生孩子的女性歌唱家。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Given all of that, the very real potential downsides of doing this, of going forward with pregnancy, what made her change her mind?
sentences.zh: 考虑到所有这些，考虑到怀孕可能带来的非常现实的负面影响，是什么让她改变了主意？

sentences.en: Well, she met a guy named Ben, and he wanted to have kids.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她遇到了一个叫本的男人，他想要孩子。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, if you want kids, you should just find someone else.
sentences.zh: 我当时说，哦，如果你想要孩子，你应该找别人。

sentences.en: You know, it's a very sort of clear...
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一种很明确的……

sentences.en: When did that conversation happen?
sentences.zh: 那次谈话是什么时候发生的？

sentences.en: Very early, I think, because we're grown-ups.
sentences.zh: 我想是很早的时候，因为我们都是成年人了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，是的。

sentences.en: You want kids, and I was like, I don't know, but if you want to, you should find someone else, because I know how important it is, if that's what you want.
sentences.zh: 你想要孩子，而我说，我不知道，但如果你想要，你应该找别人，因为我知道如果那是你想要的，这有多重要。

sentences.en: Because he said this is important.
sentences.zh: 因为他说这很重要。

sentences.en: Oh, he wanted to, and he was like, no, no, it's not that important.
sentences.zh: 哦，他想要，但他当时说，不，不，没那么重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，是的。

sentences.en: But she fell in love with him, and she was actually back in New York here singing in Strauss' De Rosenkavalier,
sentences.zh: 但她爱上了他，当时她正好回到纽约，在施特劳斯的《玫瑰骑士》中演唱，

sentences.en: and she was singing actually the role of this woman who is first confronting the passage of time.
sentences.zh: 她饰演的角色是一位首次面对时光流逝的女性。

sentences.en: And they were walking in Central Park.
sentences.zh: 他们当时在中央公园散步。

sentences.en: She and Ben.
sentences.zh: 她和本。

sentences.en: She and Ben were kind of walking in Central Park while she was here in New York for the rehearsals and performances.
sentences.zh: 当她因为排练和演出在纽约时，她和本在中央公园散步。

sentences.en: And I think just kind of thought, well, maybe I want to give this a try.
sentences.zh: 我想她当时就想，嗯，也许我想尝试一下。

sentences.en: It's something hard to know if it's because I met the right man and suddenly had the right support to think in that way at all,
sentences.zh: 很难说是因为我遇到了对的人，突然有了合适的支持去考虑这件事，

sentences.en: or if it's actually just the body saying, okay, it's now or never, and then suddenly when you think about it, it's like, okay, I want this.
sentences.zh: 还是身体在说，好吧，现在不生就没机会了，然后当你想到这一点时，就像是，好吧，我想要这个。

sentences.en: And then when we started trying, I was like, oh, but if it doesn't work, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们开始尝试时，我想，哦，但如果不行也没关系。

sentences.en: I'm going to be fine.
sentences.zh: 我会没事的。

sentences.en: But I was not fine at all.
sentences.zh: 但我一点也不好。

sentences.en: At that point, she's 39 now, so she was 36 then.
sentences.zh: 那时她39岁，所以当时是36岁。

sentences.en: And so I think there was a sense of increased urgency, obviously, to if this is going to be a decision that they make, it needs to happen as soon as possible, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有一种紧迫感增加的感觉，显然，如果这是一个他们要做的决定，它真的需要尽快发生。

sentences.en: And how did the trying work out?
sentences.zh: 尝试的结果如何？

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Not well at firSt.
sentences.zh: 起初并不顺利。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it was an incredibly difficult period.
sentences.zh: 我想那是一段极其艰难的时期。

sentences.en: I mean, she spoke to me about two miscarriages that she had had.
sentences.zh: 她跟我谈到了她经历的两次流产。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: The first being in the fall of 2023, she was in Chicago to sing the title role in Janicek's Yanufa,
sentences.zh: 第一次是在2023年秋天，当时她在芝加哥演唱雅纳切克的《耶努法》中的主角。

sentences.en: which in this terrible irony is actually about this young woman whose baby is murdered.
sentences.zh: 这真是极大的讽刺，因为这实际上讲的是一位年轻女性，她的孩子被谋杀了。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So I think I just felt extremely empty after that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在那之后，我感到极度的空虚。

sentences.en: There was nothing left.
sentences.zh: 什么都没剩下。

sentences.en: I had used all my energy and all my everything I had, really.
sentences.zh: 我真的耗尽了所有的精力，耗尽了我拥有的一切。

sentences.en: But the hard part was that it wasn't so easy, you know, to just say, oh, if this doesn't work, I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 但困难在于，这并不容易，你知道，不能仅仅说，哦，如果这行不通，我没关系。

sentences.en: Because it became like an obsession.
sentences.zh: 因为它变成了一种执念。

sentences.en: It was completely, I was like, now that's all I wanted.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样，我当时想，现在这就是我想要的一切。

sentences.en: And then a few months later, sort of in the spring of 2024, she was in Paris singing in Strauss's Zalame, which is also a very brutal and intense opera.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，大约在2024年春天，她在巴黎演唱了施特劳斯的《萨拉梅》，这也是一部非常残酷且激烈的歌剧。

sentences.en: And with that miscarriage, she didn't even miss a performance.
sentences.zh: 即便遭遇了那次流产，她甚至都没有缺席一场演出。

sentences.en: I just pretended like nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 我只是假装什么都没发生。

sentences.en: And doing this is like this intense, intense.
sentences.zh: 做这件事就像是这种强烈的、强烈的……

sentences.en: Yeah, it was quite, but it was the same as with many things that I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此，但这和我做的许多事情一样。

sentences.en: I get very, very, very, very emotional.
sentences.zh: 我会变得非常、非常、非常、非常情绪化。

sentences.en: But then to be able to cope, I just block it out, which I guess is quite human.
sentences.zh: 但为了应对，我只是把它屏蔽掉，我想这很人性化。

sentences.en: I think in both of these instances, she said she told almost no one.
sentences.zh: 我认为在这两件事上，她说她几乎没告诉任何人。

sentences.en: To do my job, I have to have a very, a lot of self-confidence, you know, like to go on stage.
sentences.zh: 为了做好我的工作，我必须非常有自信，你知道，比如上台表演。

sentences.en: And it's important for me to, in a way, keep private life and professional life separate.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，在某种程度上将私生活和职业生活分开是很重要的。

sentences.en: But then when your private life takes up everything, it was, in a way, good to have my job.
sentences.zh: 但当你的私生活占据了一切时，在某种程度上，有这份工作是件好事。

sentences.en: At least I could sing, if you do mean.
sentences.zh: 至少我还能唱歌，如果你明白我的意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I cannot imagine singing through such an intense experience with all of that pressure.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我无法想象在承受如此巨大的压力下，经历这种强烈的体验还能唱歌。

sentences.en: Was she starting to get discouraged at this point?
sentences.zh: 她当时开始感到灰心了吗？

sentences.en: Like, did she think about doing IVF?
sentences.zh: 比如，她有没有考虑过做试管婴儿？

sentences.en: She said that they went to a fertility doctor after this had happened to just say, okay, what are our options?
sentences.zh: 她说在发生这件事后，他们去看了生育医生，只是想问，好吧，我们有什么选择？

sentences.en: And it turned out that physically nothing seemed amiss.
sentences.zh: 结果发现身体上似乎没什么问题。

sentences.en: And I was like, I don't, I'd rather not do the IVF unless I have to, because I know these hormones affect the voice and it's extremely effective on the body.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我不想，除非不得已，否则我不想做试管婴儿，因为我知道这些荷尔蒙会影响嗓音，而且对身体的影响极大。

sentences.en: So I wanted to try the natural way as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望能尽可能尝试自然受孕。

sentences.en: And we continue to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们继续这样做。

sentences.en: And then he was the one who did the first scan.
sentences.zh: 然后是他做了第一次扫描。

sentences.en: And he was like, wait, there's two.
sentences.zh: 他当时说，等等，有两个。

sentences.en: And he was almost as happy as us, because he knew that we wanted more than one child.
sentences.zh: 他几乎和我们一样高兴，因为他知道我们想要不止一个孩子。

sentences.en: So it was twins.
sentences.zh: 所以是双胞胎。

sentences.en: Even without IVF, they were sort of surprised to find that they had become pregnant with twins.
sentences.zh: 即使没有做试管婴儿，他们发现怀上双胞胎时也感到有些惊讶。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Obviously a blessing.
sentences.zh: 显然是一种福分。

sentences.en: I can imagine she's totally ecstatic.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象她当时欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: And I am thinking about the fact that now all of those questions that she had about how pregnancy would affect her voice, her gift, are suddenly about to become very real.
sentences.zh: 我在想，现在她关于怀孕会如何影响她的嗓音、她的天赋的所有疑问，突然都要变成现实了。

sentences.en: I think that she was terrified.
sentences.zh: 我想她当时吓坏了。

sentences.en: I mean, I think you leave to do something like this with all of these bodily changes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为当你带着所有这些身体变化去从事这样的工作时。

sentences.en: The thought is, okay, I'm going to need to come back doing one of the hardest parts in all of opera.
sentences.zh: 你会想，好吧，我需要回来表演歌剧中最难的角色之一。

sentences.en: Everyone is going to be hanging on every note.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会关注每一个音符。

sentences.en: Everyone is going to be dissecting everything that she does.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会剖析她所做的一切。

sentences.en: So both kind of the reaction from outside and then just like, is she going to have the same voice that she had before?
sentences.zh: 所以，既有来自外界的反应，也有像，她还能拥有以前那样的嗓音吗？

sentences.en: Let's take a quick break and we'll talk about what happened and how giving birth actually affected Davinson's career when we return.
sentences.zh: 让我们休息一下，回来后我们将谈谈发生了什么，以及分娩实际上是如何影响戴文森的职业生涯的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, Zach, Davinson is in this moment, where you loved us, about to give birth.
sentences.zh: 那么，扎克，戴文森正处于这个时刻，你爱我们，即将分娩。

sentences.en: And all of these issues, the excitement, the anxiety, it's all about to become very real.
sentences.zh: 所有这些问题，兴奋，焦虑，一切都即将成为现实。

sentences.en: So let's pick it up from there.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们从那里继续。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, so she gives birth to twins, and thankfully they didn't need to do a C-section, but she had internal bleeding right after.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她生下了双胞胎，谢天谢地，他们不需要做剖腹产，但她产后立即出现了内出血。

sentences.en: So there was this very scary kind of medical procedure.
sentences.zh: 所以经历了一次非常可怕的医疗程序。

sentences.en: Very scary.
sentences.zh: 非常可怕。

sentences.en: My husband was left there in the room with these two babies, and then they just rolled me out and said, she's bleeding, and it was like, it was also one of those.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫被留在房间里照顾这两个婴儿，然后他们把我推了出去，说她正在出血，这就像，这也是其中之一。

sentences.en: I think everyone knew that this is an operation that is sort of straightforward, but for us it felt like, yeah, I was scared I was never going to see them again.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人都知道这是一个相对简单的手术，但对我们来说，感觉就像，是的，我害怕我再也见不到他们了。

sentences.en: So she had taken, I think, the couple of weeks before giving birth, totally off.
sentences.zh: 所以我想她在分娩前的几周完全休息了。

sentences.en: Like, not even practicing, not even kind of like vocalizing at all.
sentences.zh: 比如，甚至不练习，甚至根本不发声。

sentences.en: And then she said that she had taken the couple of weeks after completely off.
sentences.zh: 然后她说她在分娩后的几周也完全休息了。

sentences.en: So there was maybe like a month total in which totally no singing.
sentences.zh: 所以总共可能有一个月完全没有唱歌。

sentences.en: Not only not performing on stage, but no singing whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 不仅没有在舞台上表演，而且根本没有唱歌。

sentences.en: And so I think that there was this sense like, okay, you're going to open your mouth at the end of this couple of weeks, and like, what's going to come out?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有一种感觉，好吧，几周后你要开口了，会发出什么样的声音？

sentences.en: And all I thought about was my voice.
sentences.zh: 我满脑子想的都是我的嗓音。

sentences.en: I was like, how is my voice going to change?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我的嗓音会发生什么变化？

sentences.en: What if this happens?
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况怎么办？

sentences.en: She said that the minute she started back, she was fine.
sentences.zh: 她说她一开始工作就没事了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: She sounded fine.
sentences.zh: 她听起来很好。

sentences.en: Their voice was fine, but my head.
sentences.zh: 嗓音没问题，但我的头脑。

sentences.en: I think what she was not expecting was where her head was at.
sentences.zh: 我想她没料到的是她的心理状态。

sentences.en: I mean, the emotional aspect, which was really hard.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，情感方面，这真的很难。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那个。

sentences.en: She told me that she just felt incredibly torn about going back to singing, period.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她对重返歌唱事业感到无比纠结，真的。

sentences.en: And not just leaving the house for a rehearsal, but literally going into another room to practice kind of racked her with guilt.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是离开家去排练，而是字面上走进另一个房间去练习，这让她充满了内疚感。

sentences.en: I mean, I have a practice room next to living room, so that's not like it's hard to go, but I just didn't find the strength.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，客厅旁边有一个练习室，所以去那里并不难，但我就是找不到力量。

sentences.en: It felt weird to leave them behind.
sentences.zh: 把他们留在身后感觉很奇怪。

sentences.en: Even to go to the practice room.
sentences.zh: 即使是去练习室。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: I just wanted to be near them all the time.
sentences.zh: 我只是想一直待在他们身边。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And then singing felt like such a silly thing to do.
sentences.zh: 然后唱歌感觉是一件很愚蠢的事情。

sentences.en: Singing felt like such a silly thing to do.
sentences.zh: 唱歌感觉是一件很愚蠢的事情。

sentences.en: Even that was really hard for her, let alone, I think, the sense of pivoting back to her career and being in the headspace to prepare this.
sentences.zh: 即使是那样对她来说也非常困难，更不用说，我想，那种回归职业生涯并进入准备状态的感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, I think she just wanted to be a mom.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想她只是想做一个妈妈。

sentences.en: And why did she have to pivot back to her career so quickly?
sentences.zh: 为什么她必须这么快回归职业生涯？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm not familiar with the world of opera and its maternity leave policies, but I mean, didn't she get some time off?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不熟悉歌剧界及其产假政策，但是，她没有得到一些休假时间吗？

sentences.en: She got some time off, but really only a few months,
sentences.zh: 她得到了一些休假，但实际上只有几个月，

sentences.en: and those months were going to need to be preparation intensive because she was going to have to start rehearsals for her first Isolde in Barcelona,
sentences.zh: 而这几个月需要进行密集的准备，因为她必须开始为她在巴塞罗那的第一次《伊索尔德》排练，

sentences.en: which she was singing in January before coming to the Met to do it here.
sentences.zh: 她在来大都会歌剧院演出之前，一月份就在那里演唱了。

sentences.en: And so the clock was ticking.
sentences.zh: 所以时间在流逝。

sentences.en: She needed to reenter the practice room.
sentences.zh: 她需要重新进入练习室。

sentences.en: She needed to start coaching this because, again, this wasn't a role that she had done before.
sentences.zh: 她需要开始指导这个角色，因为，再说一次，这不是她以前演过的角色。

sentences.en: This was not only something that was totally new to her, but it was one of the hardest roles in all of opera.
sentences.zh: 这不仅对她来说是全新的，而且是歌剧中最难的角色之一。

sentences.en: And then when it came time, these months later, for the family to go to Barcelona to begin rehearsals, she found that leaving the hotel,
sentences.zh: 然后几个月后，当全家去巴塞罗那开始排练时，她发现离开酒店，

sentences.en: leaving the apartment for rehearsal was unbearable.
sentences.zh: 离开公寓去排练是无法忍受的。

sentences.en: I cried almost every day when I left the home, when I saw them in the break, and I felt I failed at work.
sentences.zh: 我离开家时几乎每天都哭，当我在休息时看到他们，我觉得我在工作中失败了。

sentences.en: I felt at home, you know, this completely sense of lack of being enough and the expectations were just like building and building.
sentences.zh: 我在家里感到，你知道，这种完全缺乏满足感的感觉，期望值只是在不断增加。

sentences.en: In the beginning, in the beginning, I said, I'm just, there's no point.
sentences.zh: 起初，起初，我说，我只是，没有意义。

sentences.en: Why should I sing when I used to love it?
sentences.zh: 为什么我还要唱歌，明明我曾经那么热爱它？

sentences.en: I can't do halfway, I mean, I can't go on stage and be like practical.
sentences.zh: 我不能半途而废，我的意思是，我不能上台表现得像个实用主义者。

sentences.en: She was, I think, feeling like everything on both sides of the equation was really a disaster.
sentences.zh: 我想她觉得天平两端的一切都是一场灾难。

sentences.en: And singing, even the process of rehearsing, wasn't giving her the fulfillment that it had before.
sentences.zh: 唱歌，甚至排练的过程，都没有给她带来以前那样的满足感。

sentences.en: Yeah, this thing she's describing of failing at work and failing at home, I mean, as a mom myself, I can say this is a really common experience.
sentences.zh: 是的，她描述的这种在工作中失败和在家里失败的事情，我的意思是，作为一个母亲，我可以肯定地说，这是一种非常普遍的经历。

sentences.en: So, how did it go for her in Barcelona?
sentences.zh: 那么，她在巴塞罗那的情况如何？

sentences.en: How did the performances do?
sentences.zh: 演出表现如何？

sentences.en: Well, the reviews were all raves, and when you're in the opera world, everyone is sending around kind of bootleg tapes of people's performances.
sentences.zh: 嗯，评论都是赞美之词，当你在歌剧界时，每个人都在传阅人们表演的盗版录音。

sentences.en: And so they began to circulate.
sentences.zh: 所以它们开始流传。

sentences.en: Wow, I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 哇，我不知道这一点。

sentences.en: And it was completely clear that she had totally nailed it, that this was, again, like kind of like an Isolde for the ages.
sentences.zh: 很明显，她完全成功了，这又是一次，就像是属于那个时代的《伊索尔德》。

sentences.en: But she told me that emotionally, she was just completely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 但她告诉我，在情感上，她已经完全精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: It was familiar in the sense that it felt like, okay, I've been here before, in a way.
sentences.zh: 这很熟悉，因为感觉就像，好吧，在某种程度上，我以前来过这里。

sentences.en: And it was very scary, because I was Isolde.
sentences.zh: 这非常可怕，因为我就是伊索尔德。

sentences.en: But it gave me very little, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，它给我的很少。

sentences.en: Compared to the way that things in the past have been.
sentences.zh: 与过去的事情相比。

sentences.en: It meant little to me.
sentences.zh: 它对我意义不大。

sentences.en: To get a huge ovation, or like, oh, to know that you've done something well, or be pleased, make this.
sentences.zh: 获得巨大的欢呼，或者，哦，知道你做好了某件事，或者感到高兴，做到这一点。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: It's been my entire goal.
sentences.zh: 这一直是我全部的目标。

sentences.en: Is to make yourself happy.
sentences.zh: 就是让自己快乐。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: To make sure that when I left stage, I had done my best, and that the best was what I planned for it to be.
sentences.zh: 确保当我离开舞台时，我已经尽力了，而且那个最好的结果就是我计划中的那样。

sentences.en: All I felt in Barcelona was relieved.
sentences.zh: 我在巴塞罗那唯一的感觉就是解脱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I didn't fail.
sentences.zh: 我没有失败。

sentences.en: From the outside, this was one of like the great successes of recent years.
sentences.zh: 从外部来看，这是近年来最伟大的成功之一。

sentences.en: The opera world is like, whew, breathing such a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 歌剧界就像是，呼，松了一口气。

sentences.en: So then it was heart-rending to interview her and realize that when we were all so happy for her, she was going through this agony.
sentences.zh: 所以采访她并意识到当我们都为她感到高兴时，她却在经历这种痛苦，真是令人心碎。

sentences.en: It's not that I'm not grateful.
sentences.zh: 并不是我不感激。

sentences.en: I just have to say that.
sentences.zh: 我必须说出来。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know what you mean.
sentences.zh: 是的，我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: Because I'm very, very, very grateful I got to do it, and that I get to be here.
sentences.zh: 因为我非常、非常、非常感激我能做到这一点，而且我能来到这里。

sentences.en: But to be honest, it felt like I was someone else.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，感觉就像我是另一个人。

sentences.en: Anyway, like I was just, look, I remember going to a party afterwards, and everyone was like, oh, amazing, amazing.
sentences.zh: 总之，就像我只是，看，我记得后来去参加了一个聚会，每个人都说，哦，太棒了，太棒了。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, yeah, cool.
sentences.zh: 我想，嗯，是的，酷。

sentences.en: But it was not invested.
sentences.zh: 但我没有投入其中。

sentences.en: You're dissociated a little.
sentences.zh: 你有点解离了。

sentences.en: And I was completely empty.
sentences.zh: 我完全空虚了。

sentences.en: I think that was because I was so tired.
sentences.zh: 我想那是因为我太累了。

sentences.en: I mean, I sleep very easily compared to what I used to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，与我过去相比，我现在睡得很容易。

sentences.en: And emotionally, it was a big thing, the pressure, all these things.
sentences.zh: 在情感上，这是一件大事，压力，所有这些事情。

sentences.en: So it was like I was just drained.
sentences.zh: 当时我感觉自己整个人都被掏空了。

sentences.en: And so how does she deal with that, this dual reality of everybody being dazzled and she being in agony?
sentences.zh: 那么她是如何应对这种双重现实的呢？一方面是众人的惊叹，另一方面却是她内心的煎熬？

sentences.en: I think that she managed to get through the run in Barcelona, she said, and then was sort of dragged herself to New York, which was this hugely touted,
sentences.zh: 她说，她设法完成了巴塞罗那的演出，然后几乎是拖着自己来到了纽约，这本是一场备受瞩目、

sentences.en: like much anticipated new production, which was going to be broadcast to movie theaters worldwide.
sentences.zh: 备受期待的新制作，而且还要向全球电影院进行直播。

sentences.en: I mean, a Met production is a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大都会歌剧院的制作可是件大事。

sentences.en: There are not new productions of Tristan and Isolde every day.
sentences.zh: 《特里斯坦与伊索尔德》并不是每天都有新制作的。

sentences.en: This has been mounted specifically for her.
sentences.zh: 这是专门为她打造的。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of pressure.
sentences.zh: 所以压力非常大。

sentences.en: And she gets to New York, and I think she said things started to shift.
sentences.zh: 当她到达纽约时，我想她说情况开始发生变化了。

sentences.en: Let's take another quick break.
sentences.zh: 让我们快速休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we get back, we're going to talk about how things changed for Davidsson once she got to New York.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将讨论戴维森到了纽约之后，情况是如何改变的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Davidsson comes to New York for this new, big production.
sentences.zh: 戴维森为了这部大型新制作来到纽约。

sentences.en: How do things change for her?
sentences.zh: 她的情况发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: So even though she's doing the same role as she has done in Barcelona, this is a totally new production, different director, different concept, different cast mostly.
sentences.zh: 尽管她表演的角色和在巴塞罗那时一样，但这完全是一个新的制作，导演不同，理念不同，演员阵容也大多不同。

sentences.en: And the director has come up with some ideas that actually are kind of interesting given what she has been going through.
sentences.zh: 而且导演提出了一些想法，考虑到她所经历的一切，这些想法其实相当有趣。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你指的是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the director, Yuval Sharon, decided, and this concept came about even before he knew that she was pregnant,
sentences.zh: 嗯，导演尤瓦尔·沙伦（Yuval Sharon）决定——这个构思在他知道她怀孕之前就有了——

sentences.en: to center the idea of kind of like pregnancy and childbirth in the opera to basically introduce something that is not in Wagner's libretto to emphasize his own ideas about the piece.
sentences.zh: 将怀孕和分娩的概念作为歌剧的核心，基本上是引入了瓦格纳剧本中原本没有的内容，以强调他自己对这部作品的理解。

sentences.en: Okay, maybe here we should just quickly describe what this opera actually is about.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许我们应该先快速描述一下这部歌剧到底讲的是什么。

sentences.en: So it's a complicated opera, but basically Tristan is bringing Isolde against her will to marry his uncle.
sentences.zh: 这是一部复杂的歌剧，但简单来说，特里斯坦违背伊索尔德的意愿，带她去嫁给自己的叔叔。

sentences.en: And she is so angry that she plots to kill them both, that she wants to die and to kill Tristan as well.
sentences.zh: 她非常愤怒，于是密谋杀死他们两人，她想死，也想杀了特里斯坦。

sentences.en: So she orders her maid to make this poison.
sentences.zh: 所以她命令女仆去配制毒药。

sentences.en: But instead, the maid switches out a love potion.
sentences.zh: 但女仆却换成了爱情灵药。

sentences.en: Ah, classic.
sentences.zh: 啊，经典桥段。

sentences.en: Classic.
sentences.zh: 经典。

sentences.en: And so this starts off one of Wagner's favorite themes, which is this overwhelming forbidden love.
sentences.zh: 这开启了瓦格纳最喜欢的主题之一，即那种令人窒息的禁忌之爱。

sentences.en: And the way that this plays out, you can imagine it's not that great.
sentences.zh: 而事情的发展，你可以想象，并不怎么美好。

sentences.en: Tristan is mortally wounded.
sentences.zh: 特里斯坦受了致命伤。

sentences.en: And then he spends the whole third act kind of in this almost between death and life hallucination waiting for Isolde to arrive.
sentences.zh: 他在第三幕的大部分时间里，几乎处于生死边缘的幻觉中，等待着伊索尔德的到来。

sentences.en: And when she finally does, he dies.
sentences.zh: 当她终于赶到时，他死了。

sentences.en: And then in this kind of ecstasy, she dies too.
sentences.zh: 然后，在一种狂喜中，她也随之而去。

sentences.en: Except that in this production, she arrives and she's pregnant.
sentences.zh: 但在这个制作中，她赶到时已经怀孕了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And actually, the character through a stage double sort of gives birth and the child is carried off at the end.
sentences.zh: 实际上，角色通过舞台替身完成了分娩，最后孩子被带走了。

sentences.en: But the baby stuff isn't normally in this opera, you're saying.
sentences.zh: 但你是说，这些关于婴儿的情节通常并不在这部歌剧里。

sentences.en: Wagner didn't put it in there.
sentences.zh: 瓦格纳并没有写进去。

sentences.en: So what was the aim of the director as he put it in?
sentences.zh: 那么导演加入这些内容的目的是什么？

sentences.en: What the director told me is that he wanted to take this opera, which is often about kind of like this grim end point of this love that is death.
sentences.zh: 导演告诉我，他想通过这部歌剧——它通常被视为关于这种以死亡为终点的残酷爱情——

sentences.en: If you love someone this much, it can only end or be consummated in death.
sentences.zh: 如果你爱一个人爱到这种程度，它只能以死亡告终或在死亡中圆满。

sentences.en: And make it more about these cycles of death, life, rebirth.
sentences.zh: 将其转变为更多关于死亡、生命、重生的循环。

sentences.en: Renewal.
sentences.zh: 新生。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, Wagner was very influenced by this philosopher called Schopenhauer and this idea, almost Buddhism, which was, yes,
sentences.zh: 就像，瓦格纳深受哲学家叔本华的影响，还有这种近乎佛教的思想，即，是的，

sentences.en: this idea of the life cycle as going on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 这种生命循环不断往复的思想。

sentences.en: And actually, Tristan's mother, we know from the exposition, died in childbirth.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，我们从剧情介绍中知道，特里斯坦的母亲就是死于难产。

sentences.en: So there is this sense of mothers and birth and death, this idea of kind of the constant becoming.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一种关于母亲、出生和死亡的感悟，一种关于不断演变的理念。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then there's this synchronicity of Davidson having this role as she's dealing with all of these emotions and feelings and processing over her own birth and her own motherhood.
sentences.zh: 而戴维森在处理所有这些情绪和感受，并消化自己作为母亲的经历时，恰好出演了这个角色，这是一种巧合。

sentences.en: And I think she also, I mean, the process of birth for her was fraught.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，她自己的分娩过程也充满了艰辛。

sentences.en: She had had this internal bleeding.
sentences.zh: 她当时出现了内出血。

sentences.en: It was not an easy birth for her.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，那不是一次轻松的分娩。

sentences.en: And so she was very, she told me she was very wary about going in after having had this experience and needing to in some way enact it on stage.
sentences.zh: 所以她说，在经历了这些之后，她非常担心要上台去以某种方式重现这一过程。

sentences.en: I mean, nine months ago, it's just not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，九个月前，那真的没过多久。

sentences.en: And she's dying with all this blood, you know, it's, it was surprisingly close to home.
sentences.zh: 而且她在台上带着血迹死去，你知道，这真的太贴近现实了。

sentences.en: And do you see that emotion play out on stage?
sentences.zh: 你在舞台上能感受到那种情绪吗？

sentences.en: It's incredibly moving when she enters and is visibly pregnant and sees her dying Tristan.
sentences.zh: 当她登场时，挺着孕肚看到垂死的特里斯坦，那一幕极其感人。

sentences.en: She actually, as she's saying farewell,
sentences.zh: 实际上，当她在告别时，

sentences.en: she puts his hands on her belly so that like their farewell to each other is also like this recognition that there's going to be something that continues on after his death.
sentences.zh: 她把他的手放在自己的肚子上，仿佛他们彼此的告别也是一种认知，即在他死后，仍有生命在延续。

sentences.en: When she says, Tristan ha erwacht, she holds on the belly instead.
sentences.zh: 当她说“特里斯坦，他醒了”时，她却抚摸着肚子。

sentences.en: It's like this Tristan, not interesting.
sentences.zh: 这就像是说“特里斯坦，不，真没意思”。

sentences.en: Which I think is so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太美了。

sentences.en: So the Liebestod is to the new baby.
sentences.zh: 所以《爱之死》是唱给新生儿的。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: It's very beautiful and very, yeah, I thought it was really nice.
sentences.zh: 非常美，而且，是的，我觉得这真的很棒。

sentences.en: Isolde's final aria is called the Liebestod, which literally means love, death.
sentences.zh: 伊索尔德的最后一段咏叹调被称为《爱之死》，字面意思是爱与死。

sentences.en: And usually it's kind of this abstract, grand aria about kind of like leaving life.
sentences.zh: 通常它是一种抽象、宏大的咏叹调，关于离开人世。

sentences.en: And in this, because it was sort of directed toward a child, there was something that was so intimate and so fresh.
sentences.zh: 而在这一版中，因为它是指向一个孩子，所以有一种非常亲密和新鲜的感觉。

sentences.en: It was almost like a lullaby and begins in this small, quiet place and then goes to grandeur.
sentences.zh: 它几乎像是一首摇篮曲，从一个细小、安静的地方开始，然后走向宏大。

sentences.en: So it was a staging, which was kind of the best thing that you can hope for, which is to have a way of looking at one of these works,
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种舞台呈现，这几乎是你所能期待的最好的结果，即找到一种方式来看待这些作品，

sentences.en: which the opera lovers have listened to or seen so many times and to kind of experience this crucial moment in a new way.
sentences.zh: 歌剧爱好者们已经听过或看过无数次了，而能以一种全新的方式体验这个关键时刻。

sentences.en: This all sounds incredibly intense.
sentences.zh: 这一切听起来极其强烈。

sentences.en: You said things had shifted for Davidson during this production.
sentences.zh: 你说戴维森在这次制作期间情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么变了？

sentences.en: Like, what was different?
sentences.zh: 有什么不同？

sentences.en: And did it have to do with this intensity?
sentences.zh: 这和这种强度有关吗？

sentences.en: As hard as going back to work is, I think that she said that going to rehearsals, engaging with this character is also a way of like anchoring yourself.
sentences.zh: 尽管重返工作岗位很难，但她说参加排练、投入到这个角色中，也是一种让自己稳住心神的方式。

sentences.en: I mean, finding a new kind of commitment to the work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对工作找到了一种新的承诺感。

sentences.en: I mean, a way of being engaged and moved by the work that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 一种被你所做的工作所吸引和感动的方式。

sentences.en: And she was saying that I think the hormones began to calm down.
sentences.zh: 她说，我想荷尔蒙开始平静下来了。

sentences.en: Time is passing.
sentences.zh: 时间在流逝。

sentences.en: And so that separation that was impossible in December became a few months later more bearable, difficult, but more bearable.
sentences.zh: 所以那种在十二月时无法承受的分离，几个月后变得更容易忍受了，虽然依然困难，但更可承受了。

sentences.en: And are her babies with her?
sentences.zh: 她的孩子们和她在一起吗？

sentences.en: Like, what is her interaction with them when she's on something like this?
sentences.zh: 比如，当她做这种工作时，她和他们的互动是怎样的？

sentences.en: So Ben and the kids traveled with her, and so she was living with them in New York.
sentences.zh: 本和孩子们跟着她一起旅行，所以她和他们住在纽约。

sentences.en: It is better now, I must say that.
sentences.zh: 现在好多了，我必须这么说。

sentences.en: It is—I know they are fine.
sentences.zh: 确实——我知道他们很好。

sentences.en: I know they are happy with their aunt Nani at home and my husband.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们和家里的娜妮阿姨还有我丈夫在一起很开心。

sentences.en: They're very pleased when I get home, which is very cute, and I just hold on and hope they will keep being happy.
sentences.zh: 我回家时他们很高兴，这非常可爱，我只是紧紧抱着他们，希望他们能一直快乐下去。

sentences.en: And of course, anything you practice, you get better at, you see what I mean?
sentences.zh: 当然，任何事情你练习多了，都会变得更好，你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: So that's also been practicing for me to, like, be away and then come home.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这也是一种练习，练习如何离开，然后再回家。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: I wonder, and I don't know if you asked her this, Zach, but if it's possible that part of the reason she may be more okay with being at work, less dissociated,
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，扎克，不知道你有没有问过她，但她之所以能更从容地工作，减少那种疏离感，是否部分原因是，

sentences.en: is that this opera, this production, is in some really profound ways about motherhood.
sentences.zh: 这部歌剧、这个制作在某种深刻的层面上是关于母性的。

sentences.en: So suddenly her work is focused on the thing that she wants to spend her time thinking about.
sentences.zh: 所以突然间，她的工作重心就放在了她想花时间思考的事情上。

sentences.en: Like, the two worlds have become less separate.
sentences.zh: 就像，这两个世界不再那么割裂了。

sentences.en: She said that she had been really scared about this new concept, but she said that by the end it was really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 她说她一开始对这个新概念感到非常害怕，但她说最后效果真的很美。

sentences.en: And the—I think that being able to sort of go through that and to sort of experience on some level a mother saying goodbye to a child as well,
sentences.zh: 而且——我认为能够经历这一切，并在某种程度上体验一位母亲向孩子告别，

sentences.en: metaphorically, but to be able to do that night after night, it was meaningful and I think cathartic for her.
sentences.zh: 虽然是隐喻性的，但能够夜复一夜地这样做，这对她来说是有意义的，我认为也是一种宣泄。

sentences.en: And, I mean, allowed on some level to kind of work through is really complicated, difficult emotions that she had been going through.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，在某种程度上让她能够处理她所经历的那些极其复杂、困难的情绪。

sentences.en: One of the things we dissolved is this, and especially this emotional part with her, that she's so emotional, but she has to be so strong.
sentences.zh: 我们消解的一件事就是这个，尤其是她身上这种情感的部分，她情感如此丰富，但又必须表现得如此坚强。

sentences.en: I think I recognize that, not just because, oh, I'm so strong enough to be so cool, but because of my job, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想我能理解这一点，不仅仅是因为“哦，我足够坚强，可以表现得若无其事”，而是因为我的工作，你知道，

sentences.en: we are presented with this pages upon pages with emotions and you pour out and then suddenly afterwards, great, have a good week.
sentences.zh: 我们面对的是一页又一页的情感，你倾注了所有，然后突然间，结束后，太棒了，祝你下周愉快。

sentences.en: Yeah, great.
sentences.zh: 是啊，太棒了。

sentences.en: Back to life.
sentences.zh: 回归生活。

sentences.en: Which is a joy and it's a gift to be able to work with that.
sentences.zh: 能够从事这份工作是一种快乐，也是一种天赋。

sentences.en: But it's also, yeah, it's healing and it's tiring.
sentences.zh: 但同时，是的，它既是治愈的，也是令人疲惫的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's challenging.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有挑战性。

sentences.en: I mean, it's definitely, like, the boundaries are strange.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这绝对是，界限很奇怪。

sentences.en: But I like that that's possible.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢这种可能性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Zach, from what you've described,
sentences.zh: 扎克，从你的描述来看，

sentences.en: this whole journey for Davidson seems to have really been about the struggle internally over whether it's possible for her to be as committed to her job, and in this case, her art,
sentences.zh: 戴维森的整个旅程似乎真的在于内心的挣扎，即她是否可能在致力于工作——在这种情况下是她的艺术——的同时，

sentences.en: while being as committed to parenthood as she wants to be.
sentences.zh: 又能像她希望的那样致力于为人父母。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering, where do you think she has landed on that question?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你认为她在这个问题上得出了什么结论？

sentences.en: As a parent myself, I can say the idea of landing anywhere permanently is sort of a euphemistic thought.
sentences.zh: 作为一名家长，我可以告诉你，想要永久地定格在某个状态的想法是一种委婉的说法。

sentences.en: You're kind of constantly updating and changing that stasis point.
sentences.zh: 你是在不断地更新和改变那个平衡点。

sentences.en: But where is she at right now?
sentences.zh: 但她现在处于什么状态？

sentences.en: She said she's not sure.
sentences.zh: 她说她不确定。

sentences.en: She said that she and her husband are going to take time this summer to really think about her future.
sentences.zh: 她说她和丈夫打算今年夏天花点时间认真考虑她的未来。

sentences.en: And think about the way she wants her schedule to be and the way that she wants the travel to be.
sentences.zh: 考虑她想要的日程安排，以及她想要的旅行方式。

sentences.en: When you're an opera singer, you are traveling and performing constantly.
sentences.zh: 当你是一名歌剧演员时，你必须不断地旅行和演出。

sentences.en: It's really not this grounded thing.
sentences.zh: 这真的不是那种脚踏实地的工作。

sentences.en: This isn't like a normal nine-to-five job.
sentences.zh: 这不像朝九晚五的正常工作。

sentences.en: She's, I mean, she's living in another universe.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她生活在另一个宇宙里。

sentences.en: Completely.
sentences.zh: 完全是。

sentences.en: And it's hard enough when it's just you.
sentences.zh: 而且当你独自一人时，这已经够难了。

sentences.en: And so to really need to be taking care of baby twins as well, it's a huge thing.
sentences.zh: 所以还需要照顾一对双胞胎婴儿，这真的是一件大事。

sentences.en: And I think she really wants to think about the future in a way that kind of takes into account her new family.
sentences.zh: 我认为她真的很想以一种考虑到她新家庭的方式来思考未来。

sentences.en: So it's funny.
sentences.zh: 所以这很有趣。

sentences.en: I mean, the opera world is now going to be watching her in the same way that they were watching her in terms of when she was pregnant, in terms of, we're counting on you.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，歌剧界现在会像关注她怀孕时那样关注她，即“我们指望你了”。

sentences.en: What is going to happen?
sentences.zh: 会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Are you going to still be wanting to sing all over the place at the highest level for 10 or 20 more years?
sentences.zh: 你还会想在未来10年或20年里继续在世界各地以最高水平演唱吗？

sentences.en: Or might she really want to ramp down a lot?
sentences.zh: 还是她真的想大幅减产？

sentences.en: I mean, she is scheduled to sing the starring role, as I said, in Wagner's Ring Cycle at the Met and elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如我所说，她计划在大都会歌剧院和其他地方演唱瓦格纳《指环》系列中的主角。

sentences.en: Another role that, like Isolde, is one of those things that if you love opera, you're like, this is the role that she was born to sing.
sentences.zh: 另一个角色，就像伊索尔德一样，是那种如果你热爱歌剧，你就会觉得“这就是她天生要唱的角色”。

sentences.en: And so everyone is waiting for that.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都在等待那个时刻。

sentences.en: But then she could decide, I'm not, I don't want to do it.
sentences.zh: 但她也可能决定，我不，我不想做了。

sentences.en: Obviously, I think what she's going through, mothers, parents in general will immediately relate to.
sentences.zh: 显然，我认为她所经历的一切，母亲们、家长们通常都会感同身受。

sentences.en: But I actually think anyone who has gone through a profound change in their life will recognize it.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，任何经历过人生重大转变的人都会产生共鸣。

sentences.en: You know, having a kid, experiencing loss, these life-changing moments where you just aren't who you used to be all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有了孩子，经历了失去，这些改变人生的时刻，让你突然间不再是以前的自己了。

sentences.en: The things that used to be important to you aren't anymore.
sentences.zh: 曾经对你重要的事情，现在不再重要了。

sentences.en: Your focus has changed in ways that are impossible to ignore.
sentences.zh: 你的关注点发生了无法忽视的改变。

sentences.en: That forces you to reacclimate to the world, to your career, to everything.
sentences.zh: 这迫使你重新适应这个世界，适应你的职业，适应一切。

sentences.en: To totally readjuSt.
sentences.zh: 彻底重新调整。

sentences.en: And I think she totally recognizes that she does what she does on a level that is a gift.
sentences.zh: 我认为她完全意识到，她所做的事情是一种天赋。

sentences.en: And yet, I think she can't ignore that her emotional world is totally different.
sentences.zh: 然而，我认为她无法忽视自己的情感世界已经完全不同了。

sentences.en: She said, I've changed.
sentences.zh: 她说，我变了。

sentences.en: This is not the person that I was before.
sentences.zh: 我不再是以前的那个我了。

sentences.en: The voice has not changed, but I am a different person.
sentences.zh: 声音没变，但我已非昨日之人。

sentences.en: Well, Zach, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，扎克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Lisa Davidsson concluded her run of Tristan and Isolde last night.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·戴维森昨晚结束了《特里斯坦与伊索尔德》的演出。

sentences.en: She's scheduled to open the Mets fall season in September as the lead in Verdi's Macbeth.
sentences.zh: 她计划于九月在大都会歌剧院秋季演出季开幕时，领衔主演威尔第的《麦克白》。

sentences.zh: 由温迪·多尔剪辑，迈克尔·伯努瓦协助。

sentences.zh: 我们的制作经理是弗兰妮·卡托斯。

sentences.zh: 节目包含丹·鲍威尔和黛安·王创作的音乐，由索菲亚·兰德曼负责工程录制。

sentences.zh: 他们睡觉时需要完全遮光吗？

sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？
